content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Overview ## slug: allocations ## seoTitle: Overview ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End {{variable.Object_Allocation}}s allow you to distribute funds from a single {{variable.Object_Transaction}} to either multiple {{variable.Object_Invoice}}s or multiple {{variable.Object_LineItem}}s on one {{variable.Object_Invoice}}. For example, when a payment is made for four {{variable.Object_Invoice}}s using the same {{variable.Object_Transaction}}, {{variable.Object_Allocation}}s help to split the funds across those four {{variable.Object_Invoice}}s. ![H_01_01_Overview](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_01_01_Overview.png){height="" width=""} ## Use Cases 1. You receive a bulk payment and distribute the payment across multiple {{variable.Object_Invoice}}s. For example, one $10,000 payment can be applied from one {{variable.Object_Transaction}} across multiple {{variable.Object_LineItem}}s on the same {{variable.Object_Invoice}}. 2. Auto-create an {{variable.Object_Allocation}} record for each {{variable.Object_LineItem}} as part of a paid {{variable.Object_Event}} checkout. 3. Manually create full or partial refund {{variable.Object_Allocation}}s between a {{variable.Object_Transaction}} and one or more {{variable.Object_LineItem}}s. ## Write-Off Allocation Feature This feature empowers users to define the process for creating write-off {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s based on their unique requirements. Admins have the flexibility to implement {{variable.Object_Allocation}}s using a variety of tools including Screen flows, Approval Processes, and other custom workflows to generate write-off {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s. Write-off {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s also provide a way to deduct amounts from an {{variable.Object_Invoice}} while maintaining an accurate, individual record of the {{variable.Object_Transaction}}. This provides granular level control of how amounts (payments/refunds/write offs) are allocated and recorded for reporting purposes. ### How It Works The {{variable.Object_Allocation}} object now supports a {{variable.Object_Transaction}} with {{variable.Field_Transaction_TransactType}} = “Write Off”. When an {{variable.Object_Allocation}} record is created, it's related to an {{variable.Object_Invoice}}, a {{variable.Object_LineItem}}, and a {{variable.Object_Transaction}}. The {{variable.Object_Allocation}} record represents the allocation of a partial amount of the total {{variable.Object_Transaction}} {{variable.Field_Transaction_Amount}} to a particular {{variable.Object_LineItem}} on an {{variable.Object_Invoice}}. The {{variable.Object_Invoice}} object also includes the {{variable.Field_Invoice_WriteOffAmount}} field which automatically adds up all the write-off {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s associated with each {{variable.Object_Invoice}}. The write-off total is also considered when calculating the {{variable.Object_Invoice}} roll-up field values in the Totals and Financials section of the {{variable.Object_Invoice}} page layout. ### New Fields * {{variable.Object_Invoice}} object: {{variable.Field_Invoice_WriteOffAmount}} field * Field Label: {{variable.Field_Invoice_WriteOffAmount}} * API Name: bt_stripe__Write_Off_Amount__c * Description: If write-off {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s are related, then this field is automatically populated. If no write-off {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s are present, then this field will be blank. * {{variable.Object_LineItem}} object: {{variable.Field_LineItem_AmtWrittenOff}} field * Field Label: {{variable.Field_LineItem_AmtWrittenOff}} * API Name: bt_stripe__Amount_Written_Off__c * Description: Auto-populates when a write off {{variable.Object_Allocation}} is related to {{variable.Object_LineItem}}. ## Parent Object Relationship {{variable.Object_Allocation}}s are related to {{variable.Object_Invoice}}, {{variable.Object_LineItem}}, and {{variable.Object_Transaction}} objects. The {{variable.Object_Allocation}}'s {{variable.Field_Allocation_Invoice}} lookup field is automatically populated by the {{variable.Object_LineItem}}'s {{variable.Field_LineItem_Invoice}} field. This connection relates the {{variable.Object_Allocation}} record to the {{variable.Object_LineItem}}, {{variable.Object_Invoice}}, and the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} that paid for the {{variable.Object_Invoice}}. With the addition of the write-off {{variable.Object_Allocation}}, the following updates will be made when an {{variable.Object_Allocation}} record is created. * The related {{variable.Object_LineItem}} fields will be updated. * {{variable.Field_LineItem_AmtWrittenOff}} * {{variable.Field_LineItem_BalanceDue}} = {{variable.Field_LineItem_Total}} - ({{variable.Field_LineItem_BalancePaid}} + {{variable.Field_LineItem_AmtWrittenOff}}) * The related {{variable.Object_Invoice}} field will be updated. * {{variable.Field_Invoice_AllocationRollup}} field = {{variable.Object_LineItem}} {{variable.Field_LineItem_BalancePaid}} - ({{variable.Object_LineItem}} {{variable.Field_LineItem_AmountRefunded}} + {{variable.Object_LineItem}} {{variable.Field_LineItem_AmtWrittenOff}}) * The {{variable.Object_LineItem}}’s {{variable.Field_LineItem_BalanceDue}} field updates to reflect changes to {{variable.Object_LineItem}} fields, including {{variable.Field_LineItem_UnitPrice}}, {{variable.Field_LineItem_Quantity}}, and {{variable.Field_Invoice_WriteOffAmount}}. ## Allocation Rollup Calculations The following calculations include write-off amounts and the new fields on the {{variable.Object_Invoice}} and {{variable.Object_LineItem}} records. ### Balance Paid When {{variable.Object_Allocation}} {{variable.Field_Allocation_Type}} = "Payment" is associated with a {{variable.Object_LineItem}} object, the value is automatically rolled up to the {{variable.Object_LineItem}}’s {{variable.Field_LineItem_BalancePaid}}. ### Amount Refunded When {{variable.Object_Allocation}} {{variable.Field_Allocation_Type}} = "Refund" is associated with a {{variable.Object_LineItem}} object, the value is automatically rolled up to the {{variable.Object_LineItem}}’s {{variable.Field_LineItem_AmountRefunded}}. ### Amount Written Off When {{variable.Object_Allocation}} {{variable.Field_Allocation_Type}} = "Write Off" is associated with a {{variable.Object_LineItem}} object, the value automatically rolled up to the {{variable.Object_LineItem}}’s {{variable.Field_LineItem_AmtWrittenOff}}. ### Balance Due {{variable.Object_LineItem}} {{variable.Field_LineItem_BalanceDue}} = {{variable.Object_LineItem}} {{variable.Field_LineItem_Total}} - ({{variable.Object_LineItem}} {{variable.Field_LineItem_BalancePaid}} + {{variable.Object_LineItem}} {{variable.Field_LineItem_AmtWrittenOff}}) ### Retained Amount {{variable.Object_LineItem}} {{variable.Field_LineItem_RetainedAmount}} = {{variable.Object_LineItem}} {{variable.Field_LineItem_BalancePaid}} - ({{variable.Object_LineItem}} {{variable.Field_LineItem_AmountRefunded}}) ### Total {{variable.Object_LineItem}} {{variable.Field_LineItem_Total}} = {{variable.Object_LineItem}} {{variable.Field_LineItem_Net}} + {{variable.Object_LineItem}} {{variable.Field_LineItem_Tax}} - {{variable.Object_LineItem}} {{variable.Field_Invoice_WriteOffAmount}} ### Allocation Rollup {{variable.Object_Invoice}} {{variable.Field_Invoice_AllocationRollup}} = (the sum of all {{variable.Object_Allocation}} {{variable.Field_Allocation_Type}} = “Payment”) – (The sum of all {{variable.Object_Allocation}} {{variable.Field_Allocation_Type}} = “Refund” + the sum of all {{variable.Object_Allocation}} {{variable.Field_Allocation_Type}} = “Write off”)
